A '''government''' presided over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam'ta]] during the [[Galactic War]], between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. An individual affiliated with the Republic visited Nam'ta at that [[Time/Legends|time]] to convince the government to repress an [[Unidentified organization (Nam'ta)|organization]] that was planning to leak thousands of [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecords]] of the Galactic Republic.
